revision_authority: User explicitly replaced the prior joint return-and-drawdown hard gate.

acceptance_priority.return_requirement: For every mandatory exact case, Quant terminal wealth must be at least the highest terminal wealth among the four references.
acceptance_priority.drawdown_objective: After the return requirement is met, minimize Quant maximum drawdown.
acceptance_priority.ideal_drawdown_target: In the same exact case, Quant maximum drawdown should be strictly below the largest maximum drawdown among the four references.

thresholds.return_floor: max(reference_terminal_wealth for the four references in the exact case)
thresholds.drawdown_target: max(reference_max_drawdown for the four references in the exact case)

joint_gate.min_return_ratio: min(quant_terminal_wealth / return_floor over every mandatory complete case)
joint_gate.hard_requirement: min_return_ratio >= 1.0 and zero mandatory incomplete cases
joint_gate.drawdown_diagnostic: min(drawdown_target - quant_max_drawdown over every mandatory complete case)
joint_gate.ideal_drawdown_outcome: all mandatory complete cases have drawdown_target - quant_max_drawdown > 0
selection_order: among candidates with min_return_ratio >= 1.0, maximize min_drawdown_margin
then compare median return advantage, median drawdown advantage, cost, turnover and stability
prefer the simplest fully integrated candidate when economics are otherwise equivalent

production_gate.economic_acceptance_definition: Every mandatory complete case meets the return hard gate and there are zero mandatory incomplete cases.
